settings.subheading: Fragrance that's good for your home and the planet.

settings.heading: Our Commitment
settings.intro: We believe that the things we bring into our homes should be made with care — for the people who make them, for the spaces where they live, and for the planet we all share.
settings.commitment_text_1: We use only 100% soy wax, phthalate-free fragrances, and cotton wicks. No paraffin, no synthetic dyes, no harmful chemicals.
settings.commitment_text_2: Our ceramic vessels are designed to be refilled, not discarded. When your candle is done, order a refill and keep the vessel.
settings.commitment_text_3: Every candle is hand-poured in our Portland studio, supporting local jobs and reducing our carbon footprint.
